title: Quantum-enhanced long short-term memory with attention for spatial permeability prediction in oilfield reservoirs
core_idea: Introduce a quantum-enhanced LSTM with attention (QLSTMA) that embeds variational quantum circuits into the recurrent cell to leverage quantum principles (entanglement, superposition) for spatial prediction of reservoir permeability; design two quantization structures (shared gates and independent gates) to study the impact of quantum configuration and qubit number, and propose a quantum–classical hybrid framework aimed at deployment on quantum hardware and extension to petroleum engineering and geoscience.
tldr: Proposes a hybrid quantum-classical LSTM with attention that integrates variational quantum circuits and two gate configurations to explore qubit effects for improving spatial permeability prediction in reservoirs.
